epics.title: Resolve Codebase Retrieval Timeout
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiologist or researcher relies on the deployed product, I want the system deployment to successfully retrieve the source code without timing out, so that the application is consistently available and up to date.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce codebase retrieval timeout failures to 0%
requirements: R1: Ensure the source code can be successfully cloned with depth 1 within a 120-second threshold.

slices.title: Optimize Codebase Retrieval
slices.jtbd: When implementing repository size optimizations for this epic, I want to ensure the clone operation finishes within 120 seconds, so that the system deployment successfully retrieves the source code without timing out.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean deployment environment, When a shallow git clone operation is initiated, Then it must successfully complete within 120 seconds.
Given the repository structure, When fetched, Then no overly large or blocking objects should prevent the clone operation.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% success rate for shallow clone operations under 120 seconds
